fila1.descripcion: Graduates will be able to analyze, design, develop, and implement software and hardware systems; manage IT projects; apply engineering methodologies and standards; and communicate results orally and in writing in professional and academic settings.
fila1.textoExtra: Computer engineers can work in public and private sector organizations in software development, databases, networks, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, teaching and research, as well as in technology entrepreneurship.

fila2.descripcion: Applicants are encouraged to have a solid foundation in mathematics (algebra, geometry, precalculus), logical and abstract reasoning skills, as well as an interest in technology and solving problems using computers.
fila2.textoExtra: It is desirable to have analytical skills, teamwork ability, discipline for self-directed study, scientific curiosity, and a willingness to continuously update one's knowledge in a constantly evolving field.

mision.descripcion: To educate computer engineering professionals with a strong scientific and humanistic foundation, capable of analyzing, designing, implementing, and managing technological solutions that contribute to societal development, in alignment with UNAM principles and values.

vision.descripcion: To be a leading academic program in computer engineering education, recognized for teaching quality, engagement with industry, and contributions to innovation, research, and the training of professionals committed to Mexico.

valores.descripcion: Honesty, responsibility, respect, equity, freedom of thought and critique, commitment to academic excellence, collaborative work, and service to the university community and society.

pasos.tituloSeccion: Get your degree in 3 simple steps

paso1.descripcion: These are the certificates you have obtained throughout your academic journey.

paso2.titulo: Choose and complete your degree certification modality
paso2.descripcion: Choose according to your interests and personal goals—you should enjoy the process!

paso3.titulo: Track your status and receive your degree
paso3.descripcion: Congratulations! you are now a graduate of the Computer Engineering program.

filaInicio.col1: Gather the official documents that support your academic record. These certificates are essential to begin any degree certification process.
filaInicio.col2: Make sure each document is legible, valid, and in the format required by the faculty. Keep digital and physical copies for your file.

filaFin.col1: Once you have completed all seven items on this list, you will have gathered the basic documentation needed to move forward.
filaFin.col2: Keep your originals safe and submit documents according to instructions from the program office or the appropriate service desk.

doc1.texto: Request a recent certified copy. It must match the personal data on your school file and other official documents.

doc2.texto: Submit a legible, valid copy. Check that your name, date of birth, and alphanumeric code are correct.

doc3.texto: Include the original certificate or a certified copy from upper secondary school, with the issuing institution's seal and signature.

doc4.texto: Obtain the complete undergraduate transcript from the school office. Verify that it lists all credited courses.

doc5.texto: It must confirm completion of social service according to faculty regulations and the academic program requirements.

doc6.texto: Submit valid proof of the foreign language requirement according to the study plan and current regulations.

doc7.texto: Prepare photographs in the format and quantity required for degree procedures. They must be recent with a white background.
